ledger.note: Searched the Wisconsin Gas Lateral with the Ixonia and Germantown names and LNG. The sources describe the lateral as a gas line from the Guardian Pipeline terminus to distribution facilities in Brookfield and Germantown. The only LNG found near it is the Ixonia LNG peaking plant, a local storage and vaporization facility for utility peak service, not an export or import terminal. No source ties this lateral to LNG exports.

Searched the Worsham-Steed Pipeline with LNG. The sources describe a Texas line serving Barnett Shale producers and NorTex storage customers, including a trade press report from the 2000s on its start of flows. No source ties it to an LNG terminal or export.

Searched Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline with LNG export and feedgas. Found only general studies of Rockies gas routes to LNG export terminals, which do not name the Kanda Lateral or any Wyoming Interstate line. No source ties this lateral to LNG exports.

Searched Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline with LNG export and feedgas. The sources describe the whole 800-mile Kinder Morgan system and general Rockies export-route studies. None names this system as delivering gas to an LNG terminal, so the main line stays blank.
Searched Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline with LNG export and feedgas. Found no source naming the Medicine Bow Lateral in connection with LNG. The EIA entry gives no demand served and no LNG text.

Searched Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline with LNG export and feedgas. The Medicine Bow Lateral Loop appears only in the EIA table and a 2002 equipment trade article, and neither mentions LNG. No source ties this loop to LNG exports.

Searched Wyoming Interstate Gas Pipeline with LNG export and feedgas. The Piceance Line appears in the EIA table and a 2005 Federal Register notice, and neither mentions LNG. No source ties it to LNG exports.

Searched the Yuma Pipeline with LED Enterprises and LNG Mexico. The FERC docket and trade press describe gas for Yuma area power demand and northwest Mexico, not feed for an LNG terminal. The project is not approved. No source ties it to LNG exports.
